description_en: Gets the workflow drafts that were recently updated or created by the current user
description_zh: 获取当前用户最近更新或创建的工作流草稿
kebab_example: aliyun paistudio list-recent-experiments --order DESC --source PaiStudio --type Modified --workspace-id 86995 --page-number 2 --page-size 20 --api-version 2021-02-02 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListRecentExperiments

parameters.help_en:
Sort by modification time. Default value: DESC.
DESC: descending order.
ASC: ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
按修改时间排序，默认DESC：
DESC：降序。
ASC：升序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The source from which the workflow draft was created
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The query type. Valid values:
Modified: the list of recently modified workflow drafts.
Created: the list of recently created workflow drafts
parameters.help_zh:
查询类型，目前有
Modified: 最近修改过的工作流草稿列表
Created：最近创建过的工作流草稿列表
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The page number for paginated queries. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时的页码，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paginated queries. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，默认为10
parameters.name: page_size
